name: Welding & Joining of Materials
summary: Explains how materials are joined by welding, brazing, soldering, adhesives and mechanical fastening, and the metallurgy of the joint.

topics.name: Fusion welding processes: arc (SMAW, GMAW, GTAW), plasma, laser and electron-beam welding
Weld thermal cycles and heat input
Weld metallurgy: fusion zone solidification, heat-affected zone and weldability
Weld defects: porosity, hot cracking, cold (hydrogen) cracking and lack of fusion
Welding of aluminium, titanium, stainless steel and superalloys
Solid-state joining: friction stir welding, inertia/linear friction welding, diffusion bonding
Adhesive bonding: surface preparation, adhesive types and joint design
Residual stress, distortion and post-weld heat treatment; weld qualification
